detail.longDescription: # research question (especially seeking # neurodivergent perspectives): I want to capture themes and ideas from books and lectures I consume, but not for a particular project yet. What systems do you use to organize ideas, quotes, thoughts, themes from media and lectures so you can later find them by not only author , but topics, and eventually cite them? I’m visual thinker and also am hoping for non-electronic or low tech solutions (so not a spreadsheet or app, please)
